messages:
Maria H: quick heads-up: sdk-bootcamp sample fails under edge/ESM ts build. only when moduleResolution=nodenext.
Maria H: tsc error: 
Maria H: ```
src/client.ts:45:13 - error TS2769: No overload matches this call.
  Overload 1 of 2, '(opts: RequestOptions): Promise<Response)', gave the following error.
    Type 'unknown' is not assignable to type 'string | Buffer'
```
Maria H: same code compiles fine with CJS settings. seems like generic inference is degrading to unknown for one of our overloads.
Tim L: do you have a minimal tsconfig? nodenext changes conditional export/type resolution.
Maria H: snippet: ```json {"compilerOptions":{"module":"esnext","moduleResolution":"nodenext","target":"es2022","lib":["es2022","dom"],"strict":true}} ```
Kevin P: is this failing in tsc or after bundler?
Maria H: tsc itself during pnpm -w build.
Suzanne B: SDK exports overloads for request<T>(opts) and request(opts)? conditional resolution can cause one overload to be picked up differently.
Tim L: short term: cast or call with explicit generic, e.g. request<string>(...). but we need SDK types that work for both ESM and CJS.
Kevin P: also saw a related runtime quirk: retries on 401 in edge lose Authorization when body is a stream (body consumed). sample uses POST ReadableStream and retry path drops header.
Maria H: yeah that makes the sample fail end-to-end.
Suzanne B: plan: I will open a PR to (1) make overloads explicit / tighten generics in types, (2) add CI compile matrix with moduleResolution=nodenext + esnext, (3) ensure SDK retry preserves auth by cloning headers/reattaching.
Tim L: I can repro locally with `tsc --module esnext --moduleResolution nodenext` and check index.d.ts conditional branches.
Kevin P: I'll own the retry header fix and add an edge runtime integration job in GH Actions to prevent regressions.
deploy-bot: canary: edge-compile+integration job queued :rocket:
